identity.name: Posibolt Helpdesk
identity.description: Native YouTrack Helpdesk for client support tickets — L1/L2 support with escalation states. SA uses Zoho Desk for L1, YouTrack for escalations.

goals: Provide timely L1/L2 support with clear SLA tracking and escalation paths
Reduce average resolution time for client tickets
Improve escalation flow between Zoho Desk (L1) and YouTrack (L2/dev) in SA
Track and reduce repeat issues to surface systemic product problems

milestones.name: Zoho Desk → YouTrack escalation flow documented and measured
SLA targets defined and tracked per region

risks.description: Zoho Desk → YouTrack escalation path has gaps — tickets get lost between systems
risks.mitigation: Document and test the full escalation flow; add tracking for tickets in transit between systems

risks.description: Support load increases as POS X launches alongside V8 (two products to support)
risks.mitigation: Separate support queues for V8 and POS X; dedicated POS X beta support channel

dependencies.description: V8 bug resolution — support can't close tickets if dev doesn't fix
SA L1 support platform — escalation handoff to YouTrack

notes: This is a native YouTrack Helpdesk project with its own escalation states (Escalated, X Dev Ticket Created, V8 Dev Ticket Created). SA uses Zoho Desk for L1 and escalates to YouTrack for L2/dev — this handoff is a known gap. The project has Client Name, Location, and SLA-ish fields. When POS X launches, support load will temporarily increase as two products run in parallel.
